name.text: W07_Q17: Christian Religious Studies JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: Which of the following royal honors were conferred upon Joseph by Pharaoh upon appointing him Prime Minister of Egypt? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Pharaoh gave Joseph his signet ring, fine linen robes, a gold chain, and the second royal chariot (Genesis 41:42-43). Joseph was never commanded to abandon his faith in God.

name.text: W07_Q18: Christian Religious Studies JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: Which of the following virtues did Joseph consistently demonstrate throughout his thirteen years of hardship in Egypt? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Joseph demonstrated moral purity, diligence, faith in God, and radical forgiveness toward his brothers (Genesis 50:20). He rejected bitterness and revenge.

name.text: W07_Q19: Christian Religious Studies JSS1 Assessment
